analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 45.1 maintains neutral territory, up from 39.3 five days ago but not yet out of oversold. MACD histogram worsened from -0.5115 to -2.3395, reinforcing downtrend. ADX at 28.2 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (32.4) significantly exceeds +DI (15.5), showing downward pressure dominance. Volume is subdued at 0.51x the 5-day average. Current price $320.44 is above SMA5 ($312.65) but below SMA20 ($330.41). Trading within the swing support of $314.11 and resistance of $339.99. No confirmed trend reversal signals, hence wait-and-see.
